commonPrompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create one high fidelity redesigned macOS desktop settings window for SimFlutDock, a Flutter Simulator companion. The attached screenshot is a reference for product identity and existing functionality, NOT the target layout. Redesign it into an exceptionally refined realistic native macOS dark mode utility. Single straight-on window, wide 4:3 image, app fills almost the whole canvas with only a slim charcoal margin, crisp legible Russian text. Consistent design system: graphite main canvas #202124, sidebar #191a1c, inset grouped surfaces #292a2d with delicate hairline borders, restrained system blue accent, SF Pro style typography, SF Symbols line icons. No gradients, glowing decorations, invented graphs or web dashboard styling. Native traffic lights, compact 44px titlebar, left sidebar about 190px wide. Small blue phone app icon beside SimFlutDock in one unbroken line at 15px semibold, below it small "Настройки". Four compact nav rows: "Общие", "Проекты", "Инструменты", "Панель"; selected row has a subtle blue tinted background and blue icon, not a huge saturated blue slab. Bottom sidebar action "Показать панель" and small "Версия 1.0.4". Content padding 32px, section gaps 22px. Page title 25px, one muted sentence below. Clear 13px body, 11px secondary copy, good contrast. Grouped settings rows ~54px tall, labels left and controls consistently aligned to the right, helper copy directly below corresponding label; right aligned switches. Rounded rectangle radius 9px, no enormous empty cards. No duplicated giant app branding. Whole content visible without clipping. Bottom content small subtle checkmark and "Изменения сохраняются автоматически". Render the precise screen below as one coherent usable interface. All displayed project/device values are illustrative sample data, no claim about live state.
